svg.title: Provider timing is not WPF paint or useful-answer qualification
svg.desc: Explicit Ask freezes text before provider work. ACP prompt submission, first text, acknowledged session close and WPF control assignment are distinct boundaries. Usefulness is scored separately; the H benchmark does not measure the UI or optional Azure path.
